# GEVINO TFT (7" / 10")

> GEVINO TFT is an affordable, Arduino Zero compatible HMI PLC with a 7" or 10" capacitive-touch TFT (1024x600, Raio RA8876 controller), built around the Microchip SAMD21 (32-bit ARM Cortex-M0+, 48 MHz, 256 KB flash, 32 KB RAM). The 7" and 10" models are the SAME board — only the glass changes (touch controller: 7" = FT5206, 10" = GT9271, auto-detected). It provides 12 opto-isolated inputs (4 high-speed/interrupt), 8 opto-isolated outputs (PNP/NPN/AC, 1A 30V), 4 analog inputs + 1 analog output, RS485, a front USB-stick reader (CH376), a rear micro-SD and optional Ethernet/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/SIM800L/LoRa modules. Designed and manufactured by GEVA Elettronica (Italy); programmed with the Arduino IDE (Arduino SAMD core), Cursor or OpenPLC.

This repository contains the board I/O support header, the RA8876 display driver, font tables, ready-to-flash examples, the hardware manual and datasheets, and a programming guide written specifically for LLMs and AI coding agents.

## Documentation
- [README](README.md): full product overview, technical specifications, complete pin map, 7"/10" differences, installation and quick start.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): programming guide for LLMs and AI coding agents — non-blocking state-machine style, shift-register I/O (updateIO), the RA8876 display, 7"/10" touch auto-detection, front USB stick (CH376), DMA images, non-blocking ADC + DAC output, RS485 + Modbus, Ethernet (W5500), SD, the Timer class, and HTML web-UI conventions.

## Library
- [src/gevino_tft_io.h](src/gevino_tft_io.h): the board I/O header — pin/I-O macros, the extra SERCOM UARTs (Serial2/Serial3), shift-register I/O, board setup, bundled SAMD21 ADC helpers and the Timer class. Include it in ONE .ino, in the order: gevino_tft_io.h, All_76_Pic_65K.h, gevino_tft_display.h.
- src/gevinoTFT_RA8876.h / .cpp: the Raio RA8876 display driver (the `tft` object).
- src/gevino_tft_display.h: display/flash helper (copy fonts/images from SD to display flash).
- src/Horizzontal/, src/Vertical/: font tables for landscape / portrait orientation.
- [keywords.txt](keywords.txt): Arduino IDE syntax highlighting.
- [library.properties](library.properties): Arduino library metadata.

## Examples
- [GEVINO_TFT_Test](examples/GEVINO_TFT_Test/GEVINO_TFT_Test.ino): full self-test with 7"/10" touch auto-detection.
- [Multi_Touch](examples/Multi_Touch/Multi_Touch.ino): multi-touch input.
- [DMA_Pics_from_flash](examples/DMA_Pics_from_flash/DMA_Pics_from_flash.ino): fast full-screen image loading via DMA.
- [Demo](examples/Demo/Demo.ino): graphical HMI demo.
- [ADC](examples/ADC/ADC.ino) / [DAC](examples/DAC/DAC.ino): non-blocking analog input / analog output.
- [FlashUSB_Stick](examples/FlashUSB_Stick/FlashUSB_Stick.ino): front USB memory-stick read/write (CH376).
- [Key_ModBus_Inquiry](examples/Key_ModBus_Inquiry/Key_ModBus_Inquiry.ino): Modbus master over RS485.
